name: H3 native AV span continuation
operation: Extend a cumulative H3 AV latent by planning a globally aligned target, conditioning it with an extracted native AV span, and appending only an explicit generated suffix.

input_contract.name: source_native_av_latent
input_contract.cardinality: one packed cumulative H3 AV latent

output_contract.name: continued_native_av_latent
output_contract.cardinality: source plus one globally contiguous AV span

graph_contract.role: validate the cumulative packed AV latent and expose its exact frame/token geometry
resolve the absolute overlap and extension boundaries on both H3 clocks
allocate the fresh globally aligned AV target used by the sampler
extract the synchronized native tail span from the cumulative source
create prompt conditioning for exactly the planned window length; its empty latent output is not used
insert the extracted AV span at frame zero on the active positive-conditioning edge
set explicit video and structural-audio flow shifts
sample the allocated continuation window with explicit guider, sampler, scheduler, seed, and steps
extract only the explicit new suffix from the sampled window using its nonzero timeline origin
append the globally contiguous suffix without a hidden transition policy

evidence.deterministic_layer: CAUCE 3.0 AV layout/span/append operations unit-validated with synthetic packed tensors
evidence.model_layer: requires live schema validation, execution, and visual evaluation
